# [TASK] Integrate Local Cloudflare Tunnel option into Admin DeployControl UI

## Task
Update `DeployControl.jsx` to include a 'Local Workstation / Minikube (Cloudflare Tunnel)' target option with 1-click status checking, tunnel connection info, and documentation.

## Parent Story
Parent: #142

## Scope
Includes UI updates to `DeployControl.jsx`, custom tunnel URL override field, and unit tests in `DeployControl.test.jsx`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] UI provides 'Local / Minikube (Cloudflare Tunnel)' as a third target option.
- [x] Displays instructions and commands (`./infrastructure/scripts/start-tunnel.sh`) to launch the local tunnel.
- [x] Allows entering custom tunnel URL to ping backend health directly from Vercel.
- [x] Unit tests updated and passing in `DeployControl.test.jsx`.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
Delivered in commit `5615fc0`. **Rescoped:** superseded by ADR-015 along with the rest of the DeployControl surface (commit `469e304`) — the criteria below are recorded as met at delivery, not as current behaviour. Local tunnel exposure still works via `infrastructure/scripts/start-tunnel.sh`. See #138 and #150.
